text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Owowow...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! Sounds like I really did a number on it.
The doctor said, 'I can't believe you endured this.'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Well... if anything, Teacher's furious demon face was so scary it almost made me cry.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha... haha...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
......Ummm.
You were supposed to laugh at that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... That's not like you, Trainer.
Is that usual fiery passion of yours on paid leave today?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...We still have the next race ahead of us.
If you're not gonna push yourself now, when are you ever gonna do it?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You know what we need to do right now, don't you?
choice_data_list: I'll nurse you back to health with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You know what we need to do right now, don't you?
choice_data_list: I'll nurse you back to health with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, that's not it.
I should push myself—
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself like that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright! I get it already!
You don't need to be so stiflingly passionate about it!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... This isn't how it was supposed to go.
I shouldn't have gotten so uncharacteristically preachy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite pouting about it, Nice Nature
accepted the nursing and dedicated herself to recuperating...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Of cooourse.
Like I wouldn't be totally fine, c'mon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Ow, owwch...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Geez, why's it gotta hurt now of all times?
I can't look cool... like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's injury was severe...
Judging that she shouldn't be pushed right now,
I had her rest and recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I stop here,
what's out of reach will only... drift further away, right?
choice_data_list: The two of us will definitely make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, look who's talking.
Looks like you're finally back to your usual self.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well then! Let's hurry up and get this injury all healed up, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination, she focused on rapid recovery...
and successfully resumed her training!
